prompt: What is a VLAN primarily used to separate?
options: Logical Layer-2 broadcast domains
DNS zone serial numbers
Virtual disk partitions
Windows local user accounts
en: VLANs segment Ethernet traffic logically; IP subnetting is a separate addressing concept.
ru: VLANs Ethernet traffic logically segment karti hain; IP subnetting alag addressing concept hai.

prompt: Which distinction between switching and routing is accurate?
options: Switching forwards Layer-2 frames; routing connects IP networks
Switching always resolves DNS names; routing creates records
Routing requires every endpoint to share one subnet
A standard switch label automatically enables inter-subnet routing
en: Layer-2 connectivity and Layer-3 forwarding solve different problems.
ru: Layer-2 connectivity aur Layer-3 forwarding alag problems solve karte hain.

prompt: What does an A-record DNS lookup determine?
options: The IPv4 address associated with a name
The switch port that must forward a frame
The permitted VLAN list on every trunk
The active storage session’s MTU
en: DNS naming is distinct from switching, routing and traffic authorization.
ru: DNS naming switching, routing aur traffic authorization se alag hai.

prompt: What does VLAN None (0) mean for the recorded standard port groups?
options: The groups use untagged operation
All VLANs are forwarded to every guest
VLAN 0 is a normal tagged tenant VLAN
Every attached guest has address 0.0.0.0
en: In this port-group configuration, None (0) is the untagged setting.
ru: Is port-group configuration mein None (0) untagged setting hai.

prompt: What is special about VLAN 4095 on a standard VM port group?
options: It enables guest VLAN trunking in a deliberate VGT design
It is an ordinary single tenant VLAN
It sets the switch MTU to 4095
It creates 4095 guest IP addresses
en: 4095 is a special guest-trunk setting, not an ordinary VLAN to copy blindly.
ru: 4095 special guest-trunk setting hai, ordinary VLAN nahin jo blindly copy ho.

prompt: Does using different IP subnets alone prove Layer-2 isolation?
options: No; actual Layer-2 attachment and policies must also be examined
Yes; masks automatically create VLAN tags
Yes; a DNS suffix enforces subnet isolation
Only if the port-group names differ
en: Addressing choices and broadcast-domain separation must not be confused.
ru: Addressing choices aur broadcast-domain separation ko mix nahin karna chahiye.

prompt: Does tracert normally list every physical and virtual Layer-2 switch on the path?
options: No; it primarily reveals responding routed hops
Yes; every vSwitch always appears as an IP hop
Yes; every switch port is listed separately
Only switches with uppercase labels appear
en: Layer-2 forwarding devices do not necessarily appear as routed traceroute hops.
ru: Layer-2 forwarding devices lazmi routed traceroute hops ki tarah nazar nahin aate.

prompt: What is required for ordinary communication between different IP subnets?
options: An appropriate routed path and permitted traffic
Only matching port-group labels
Only identical virtual disk names
Only a CNAME on the DNS server
en: Routing and policy are necessary when traffic crosses IP networks.
ru: IP networks cross karne ke liye routing aur policy chahiye.

prompt: What does a port-group name such as SERVERS establish by itself?
options: An administrative label indicating intended purpose
A unique VLAN and security boundary
A guaranteed default gateway
An authoritative DNS zone
en: Names aid administration but do not implement segmentation alone.
ru: Names administration mein madad dete hain lekin akelay segmentation implement nahin karte.

prompt: What does an uplink provide for traffic flow?
options: A path from the ESXi switch toward an external network
A requirement for every same-host frame exchange
Automatic creation of all routes
A guarantee of Internet access for every VLAN
en: An uplink extends the path; upstream connectivity and policy still determine reachability.
ru: Uplink path extend karta hai; upstream connectivity aur policy reachability tay karti hain.

prompt: Two same-host VMs share a compatible VLAN and policies allow communication. Where can their traffic stay?
options: Within the host’s local virtual switching path
It must traverse the physical router for every frame
It must visit the DNS server for every packet
It must leave through both active uplinks
en: Local compatible traffic can be switched without an external uplink.
ru: Local compatible traffic external uplink ke baghair switch ho sakti hai.

prompt: A nested VM must reach an external LAN peer. Which conceptual sequence is appropriate?
options: Guest vNIC → port group → vSwitch → vmnic → outer Workstation/upstream path
Guest disk → DNS zone → physical monitor
VMkernel name → CNAME → guest disk
Guest vNIC → datastore → Windows user profile
en: Nested traffic crosses both the inner ESXi network and relevant outer virtual network.
ru: Nested traffic inner ESXi network aur relevant outer virtual network dono cross karti hai.

prompt: A Windows browser manages ESXi9 at 10.0.0.10. Which endpoint receives host management traffic?
options: vmk0 through its management network attachment
Every guest vNIC simultaneously
The SERVERS group name as an IP interface
The storage datastore file
en: The management VMkernel interface is the ESXi host’s IP endpoint.
ru: Management VMkernel interface ESXi host ka IP endpoint hai.

prompt: SERVERS and VM Network both use the same untagged Layer-2 network. Which statement is safest?
options: Different labels alone do not establish isolation
They are necessarily on different VLANs
Only uppercase names can communicate
A different label guarantees blocked broadcasts
en: Actual segmentation must be demonstrated by topology and policy, not labels.
ru: Actual segmentation topology aur policy se demonstrate hoti hai, labels se nahin.

prompt: STORAGE uses 172.16.0.102/16 and Management uses 10.0.0.10/24. What is not proven merely by these addresses?
options: End-to-end security isolation between the networks
That the displayed interfaces have different IP addresses
That their addressing prefixes differ
That routing should be considered for cross-subnet access
en: Separate subnets do not by themselves establish VLAN, physical or policy isolation.
ru: Alag subnets akelay VLAN, physical ya policy isolation establish nahin karte.

prompt: A VM port group is set to VLAN 20. What must the external path support for traffic to a VLAN 20 peer?
options: Compatible VLAN handling through the uplink and upstream network
Only a port-group label containing 20
A reverse DNS zone named VLAN20
A guest disk size of 20 GB
en: Tagging must align with the actual path, including the outer layer in a nested lab.
ru: Tagging actual path se align honi chahiye, nested lab mein outer layer samait.

prompt: A VM has an IP in a subnet different from its peer’s and no router exists between them. What does adding an uplink alone accomplish?
options: An external Layer-2 path, not automatic inter-subnet routing
Automatic routing between all IP subnets
Creation of the peer’s missing DNS record
A guaranteed application session
en: An uplink is not a router configuration.
ru: Uplink router configuration nahin hai.

prompt: A same-host ping succeeds while an uplink is disconnected. What is still unverified?
options: Connectivity to a peer that requires that external uplink
That the local ping succeeded
That the guests can exchange the tested local traffic
That the selected local addresses replied
en: A local path may bypass the disconnected link entirely.
ru: Local path disconnected link ko bilkul bypass kar sakta hai.

prompt: An early topology shows VLAN --, while a later SERVERS dialog explicitly shows None (0). What can be recorded?
options: The later SERVERS value, without inferring every other group’s VLAN
All groups always use VLAN 4095
Every historical group had a verified tagged VLAN
The dash proves all groups were disconnected
en: An explicit field establishes that setting only for the captured object/checkpoint.
ru: Explicit field sirf captured object/checkpoint ki us setting ko establish karti hai.

prompt: Which test separates name resolution from HTTPS TCP connectivity to the management IP?
options: Compare a name lookup with Test-NetConnection 10.0.0.10 -Port 443
Only rename the management port group
Only run a disk capacity command
Only check the DNS suffix field
en: DNS and TCP service reachability are distinct layers of a connection.
ru: DNS aur TCP service reachability connection ki alag layers hain.

prompt: A guest’s local peer works, but a VLAN 20 physical peer does not. What should be checked?
options: Tagging, uplink mapping, upstream VLAN allowance and endpoint settings
Assume local success proves upstream VLAN support
Delete all VMkernel interfaces immediately
Change the guest disk format first
en: The external tagged path can fail even when local switching works.
ru: Local switching work kare tab bhi external tagged path fail ho sakta hai.

prompt: A management VLAN change disconnects the host remotely. What is the appropriate recovery route?
options: Use console access and restore the recorded compatible settings
Blindly reset every virtual switch
Delete all guest disks
Change the DNS zone serial repeatedly
en: Console rollback can restore a broken management network without broad unrelated resets.
ru: Console rollback broad unrelated resets ke baghair management network restore kar sakta hai.

prompt: DNS resolves the expected IP, but no traffic reaches the peer after a VLAN change. What is the relevant next focus?
options: Layer-2/VLAN path, IP routing and firewall checks
Assume a correct DNS answer proves the network works
Create a new PTR as the only required fix
Set every port group to 4095 without a design
en: DNS success does not repair incompatible tagging or missing connectivity.
ru: DNS success incompatible tagging ya missing connectivity repair nahin karti.

prompt: Two Workstation NICs behind nested ESXi are on unrelated outer networks. What should not be assumed?
options: That assigning them to one team makes them equivalent paths to the same VLAN
That outer mapping can affect connectivity
That MAC mapping helps identify the adapters
That the intended topology needs inspection
en: Equivalent uplinks need compatible upstream networks; teaming does not merge unrelated networks.
ru: Equivalent uplinks ko compatible upstream networks chahiye; teaming unrelated networks merge nahin karti.

prompt: A student says zero VMs on SERVERS proves VLAN isolation passed. What is missing?
options: Actual endpoint attachment and controlled connectivity/isolation tests
Only another spelling for the label
Only a new background color
Only a longer DNS suffix
en: An empty group provides no guest traffic evidence for isolation.
ru: Khaali group guest traffic ki isolation evidence nahin deta.
